title: Packing-List Reuse Accuracy
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=outfit:wear trip_name=*
| stats dc(planned_item) as planned_items, dc(item_name) as worn_items by trip_name
| eval reuse_accuracy=round(100*worn_items/planned_items,1)
| sort - reuse_accuracy
description: Compares what you planned to pack for a trip with what you actually wore, improving future packing lists.
value: Packing data quickly shows what was optimistic, unnecessary, or repeatedly forgotten on similar trips.
implementation: Capture trip-specific outfit use with planned versus worn item fields and calculate reuse accuracy per trip.
visualization: Table of trips with planned versus worn item accuracy.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how close your packing plans are to what you really end up wearing on trips.
